notes: API-backed animated icon using Lottie. Fetches JSON at build time, inlines as animationData. Pipeline routes to Icon atom in reduced/textonly. Decorative instances (no label) hidden in textonly. Colour comes from the global .color--{name} mixin when nativeMode=false; otherwise the Lottie's baked-in colours are preserved.

content._description: What this icon is and what it represents

slug.description: Asset Library slug for the Lottie JSON. API returns paired data including the Phosphor fallback.

src.description: Legacy filesystem path. Use slug instead.

fallbackIcon.description: Phosphor icon slug for the static fallback (reduced/textonly). Auto-resolved from the Asset Library API when slug is set; pass explicitly to override.

labelLottieIcon.description: Human-readable label. Required when semanticRole is ui-control or content-symbol. Free-form (not enum-validated) per the label<Atom> pattern.

semanticRole.description: decorative = aria-hidden, hidden in textonly. ui-control = focusable interactive icon (nav, button). content-symbol = represents content meaning (heart icon for love, etc). Matches Icon.semanticRole.

colour._description: Brand-scale colour override. Only applied when nativeMode=false. Use one of brandColor or rainbowColor.

rainbow._description: Rainbow palette colour override. Only applied when nativeMode=false.

size.description: Named em-based size token (matches Icon atom enum). Undefined = inherit text size via 1em.

nativeMode.description: true (default) preserves Lottie's baked-in colours. false applies brandColor/rainbowColor via the global .color--{name} mixin (overrides every fill+stroke in the SVG).

animation._description: Motion behaviour — LottieIcon uses the global motion+hover gates via registerTrigger. Matches Icon's animationTrigger + animationRepeat shape exactly so atoms compose consistently. motion=none disables Lottie entirely (static fallback renders).

animationTrigger.description: When the animation fires. Matches Icon.animationTrigger.

animationRepeat.description: How many times to play: once, loop (infinite), three (3x then stop), threeloop (3x then pause then repeat). Default = threeloop, matches Icon.

animationInterval.description: Gap between attention-pulse bursts. Token-driven (motion-mode scaled). Used by animationRepeat=threeloop and animationTrigger=interval. Matches Icon.
